newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: ABN AMRO confirms Demachy Worms buy talks.
newsitem.headline: ABN AMRO confirms Demachy Worms buy talks.

text.p: Dutch bank ABN AMRO NV confirmed on Friday it is interested in buying French bank Demachy Worms & Cie from Worms & Cie.
"We have confirmed we have expressed our interest and that the talks are in the initial stage," ABN AMRO spokesman Jules Prast told Reuters.
But he said no financial details were available.
Worms said on Thursday it was in negotiations for the Dutch bank to take a majority stake in Demachy Worms & Cie.
Prast said Demachy Worms would make a good fit with ABN AMRO's other activities in France.
He said Demachy Worms specialised in private banking, custody and had some asset management and corporate banking activities.
